item.title: Democratic lawmaker rages against Trump over war, yells 'f--- his a--!'
item.summary: Rep. Sydney Kamlager-Dove unleashes profane attack on Trump over Iran war costs, saying "f--- his a--" while criticizing daily war spending.

item.title: State of emergency declared as US warns travelers to reconsider visiting popular getaway
item.summary: The U.S. Embassy is warning Americans to reconsider travel to Trinidad and Tobago due to crime concerns and a heightened terrorism risk on the islands.

item.title: WATCH: Illegal street racing 'takeover' explodes as hundreds swarm streets and suspects bolt
item.summary: Police say 18 people were arrested and firearms recovered after an illegal street racing takeover drew 200 to an Atlanta intersection Sunday.

item.title: Judge warned of 'very concerning' Justin Fairfax behavior weeks before Dem gunned down wife
item.summary: A judge flagged Justin Fairfax's mental health in a custody case weeks before the former Virginia lieutenant governor's murder-suicide near Washington, D.C.

item.title: Daughter of missing American in Bahamas says Brian Hooker using mother's illness as 'excuse' to leave country
item.summary: Daughter of American woman missing in The Bahamas accuses stepfather Brian Hooker of using his mother's illness as an excuse to leave the country.

item.title: Garret Anderson, who helped lead Angels to their lone World Series title, dead at 53
item.summary: Garret Anderson, a three-time All-Star and key player in the Los Angeles Angels' 2002 World Series title, has died at 53, the Los Angeles Angels announced.

item.title: UPS plane aborts landing in near miss at same airport where November crash killed 15
item.summary: A UPS cargo jet aborted its landing at Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport to avoid a smaller aircraft on the runway, reports say.

item.title: One million bees swarm highway after crash shuts down interstate ramp for hours
item.summary: A truck carrying one million bees crashed on Interstate 40 in Knoxville, Tennessee, closing part of the highway as beekeepers scrambled to contain them.

item.title: White House reviewing cases of missing, dead scientists for possible links as 11th person identified
item.summary: The White House says it is working with the FBI to review cases of American scientists who have gone missing or died in recent years in a growing list.

item.title: Greg Olsen's advice for NFL Draft first-round picks on handling high expectations
item.summary: Greg Olsen offered advice to 2026 NFL Draft first-round picks on how to handle high expectations that comes with being a top selection next week.
